title.zh: 对第 7698 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 7698 Declaring August 6 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Province of Cebu to Include its Highly Urbanized Cities of Cebu and Mandaue and its Component Cities of Lapulapu, Danao and Toledo

text.en:
Section 2 of Republic Act No. 7698 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 2. August six of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday for the Province of Cebu including its highly urbanized cities of Cebu and Mandaue and its component cities of Lapulapu, Danao and Toledo."
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
